results.message: Attested by Claude Opus 5 (AI agent), standards adoption experiment on 2026-08-10: This exact failure occurred once, was found, and is recorded rather than repaired quietly. Retraction R15: certified bounds correct for the reflection-even sector A_+ were read as statements about the whole operator A_c.
